title: Bone Mineral Density in Lunar Gravity
summary: In 1/6th lunar gravity, osteoclasts break down bone tissue faster than osteoblasts replace it. Astronauts require daily resistive exercise to preserve trabecular density.
gameplayLink: Skipping daily exercise incurs a -3 health penalty due to physiological deconditioning.

title: Microgreen Crop Photobiology (VEGGIE)
summary: NASA Veggie and Advanced Plant Habitat experiments show that red/blue light spectra optimize carotenoid and anthocyanin antioxidants in space-grown Brassica greens.
gameplayLink: Greenhouse light power directly influences crop maturation speed and nutrient yield for the crew.

title: Circadian Rhythms & Cognitive Performance
summary: Without an Earth 24-hour day/night cycle, astronauts experience circadian desynchronization, reducing motor alertness and repair task precision.
gameplayLink: Astronauts have 8 work hours after routine care (sleep, meals, exercise). Overworking causes fatigue and health degradation.

title: In-Situ Lunar Regolith Radiation Attenuation
summary: Lunar regolith (silicon, iron, aluminum oxides) provides excellent mass shielding against solar protons when compacted over base habitats.
gameplayLink: Building regolith shield layers permanently raises outpost protection from 60 to up to 90.
